nodes.description: Address of the contract owner, set in the Ownable constructor and updated by transferOwnership.
Public token symbol string, writable by owner via reName.
Public token name string, writable by owner via reName.
Public token decimals, used as exponent base in multiTransferDecimals.
Internal total token supply, set once in constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping of address to token balance; mutated by transfer/transferFrom and read by balanceOf.
Nested mapping owner=>spender=>allowance; mutated by approve/approveAndCall/transferFrom.
Ownable constructor which assigns msg.sender as the initial owner.
onlyOwner modifier requiring msg.sender == owner before executing the guarded function body.
Owner-only function that transfers contract ownership to newOwner.
Owner-only function that overwrites token symbol and name strings.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Returns the token balance of tokenOwner from the balances mapping.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using SafeMath sub/add (checks-effects-interactions, no external call).
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens without zero-first protection (double-spend allowance risk).
Transfers tokens from 'from' to 'to', deducting from balances and from allowed[from][msg.sender].
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Approves spender and then performs an external call to spender.receiveApproval(...) after the approval state update.
Loops over _addresses and calls transfer for each pair of addresses/amounts.
Loops over _addresses, scaling each amount by 10**decimals and calling transfer.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting raw ETH transfers.
IMOSToken constructor: sets metadata, mints fixed supply to msg.sender and emits Transfer.
SafeMath.add: c = a + b with require(c >= a) overflow guard.
SafeMath.sub: require(b <= a) underflow guard then c = a - b.
SafeMath.mul: c = a * b with require(a == 0 || c / a == b) overflow guard.
SafeMath.div: require(b > 0) then c = a / b.
msg.sender used in Ownable constructor to set the initial owner.
msg.sender compared against owner inside the onlyOwner modifier.
msg.sender receiving the entire initial token supply at construction time.
msg.sender whose balance is debited in transfer.
msg.sender used as the approval owner key in approve.
msg.sender used as the spender key in allowed[from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
msg.sender used as approval owner and as the 'from' argument of the external receiveApproval call.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) executed after approval state update; reentrancy surface.
Arithmetic subtraction balances[msg.sender].sub(tokens) in transfer, delegated to SafeMath.sub.
Arithmetic addition balances[to].add(tokens) in transfer, delegated to SafeMath.add.
Arithmetic subtractions on balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
Arithmetic addition balances[to].add(tokens) in transferFrom.
Arithmetic multiplication amounts[i] * 10**uint(decimals) in multiTransferDecimals.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner state variable in the Ownable constructor, establishing the privileged account.
Ownable constructor reads msg.sender to initialise ownership.
IMOSToken constructor computes the fixed supply and associates it with msg.sender.
IMOSToken constructor mints balances[msg.sender] = _totalSupply.
Constructor writes the symbol state variable.
Constructor writes the name state variable.
Constructor writes the decimals state variable.
Constructor writes _totalSupply.
Constructor writes the balances mapping for the deployer.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner; this is the sole access control gate.
onlyOwner reads the owner state variable for the require check.
onlyOwner modifier gates execution of transferOwnership.
newOwner parameter flows into the ownership reassignment.
transferOwnership writes the owner state variable, changing the privileged account.
onlyOwner modifier gates execution of reName.
_symbol parameter flows into the symbol state variable.
_name parameter flows into the name state variable.
reName mutates symbol.
reName mutates name.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the stored supply.
tokenOwner parameter is the lookup key in balanceOf.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer debits and reads balances[msg.sender].
transfer invokes the SafeMath subtraction on the sender balance.
tokens parameter is the operand of the subtraction, defining the amount debited.
Subtraction result is stored back into the balances mapping.
transfer uses the 'to' parameter as the credit key in balances.
transfer invokes the SafeMath addition on the recipient balance.
Addition result is stored back into the balances mapping.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender], keyed by the untrusted caller address.
spender parameter is the second key of the allowed mapping in approve.
tokens parameter becomes the allowance value in approve without zero-first protection.
approve mutates the allowed mapping.
transferFrom writes allowed[from][msg.sender], keyed by the untrusted caller address.
from parameter is the debit key in the balances mapping in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the operand of both subtractions in transferFrom.
transferFrom invokes SafeMath subtractions on balances[from] and on the allowance.
Subtraction result is stored back into balances[from].
Subtraction result is stored back into allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom invokes SafeMath addition on the recipient balance.
Addition result is stored back into balances[to].
to parameter is the credit key in the balances mapping in transferFrom.
tokenOwner parameter is the first key read by allowance.
spender parameter is the second key read by allowance.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using the untrusted caller address.
spender parameter is the allowance key and the external call target in approveAndCall.
tokens parameter is the allowance value set by approveAndCall.
approveAndCall immediately performs the external receiveApproval call after the state update.
msg.sender is passed as the 'from' argument to the untrusted external call.
spender controls the address of the external contract being called.
attacker-controlled data bytes are forwarded to the external call.
The external receiveApproval call can re-enter approveAndCall or other token functions before the caller's transaction completes.
Re-entering from the external call can invoke transfer and mutate balances during the callback.
_addresses array drives the multiTransfer loop recipients.
amounts array drives the multiTransfer loop values.
Loop index i indexes the arrays; unchecked i++ is an arithmetic surface.
multiTransfer internally calls transfer for every recipient.
_addresses array drives the multiTransferDecimals loop recipients.
amounts parameter is multiplied by 10**decimals in multiTransferDecimals.
multiTransferDecimals performs the decimal scaling multiplication.
Scaled amount is forwarded to transfer, propagating multiplication result into token movement.
Loop index i indexes the arrays; unchecked i++ is an arithmetic surface.
multiTransferDecimals internally calls transfer for every recipient.
Parameter a is an operand of the SafeMath addition.
Parameter b is an operand of the SafeMath addition.
Return variable c holds the addition result with overflow check.
Parameter a is an operand of the SafeMath subtraction.
Parameter b is an operand and range-check bound of the SafeMath subtraction.
Return variable c holds the subtraction result with underflow check.
Parameter a is an operand of the SafeMath multiplication.
Parameter b is an operand of the SafeMath multiplication.
Return variable c holds the multiplication result with overflow check.
Parameter a is the dividend of the SafeMath division.
Parameter b is the divisor, protected by require(b > 0) against division by zero.
Return variable c holds the division result.
Payable fallback reverts, so no ETH is accepted and no state is touched.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is a boundary value only consumed by transferOwnership when reassigning the owner state variable.
_symbol is a boundary value written into the symbol state variable by reName.
_name is a boundary value written into the name state variable by reName.
tokenOwner is only a lookup key for the balances mapping inside balanceOf.
to is the recipient key of the balances write in transfer.
tokens is the operand of the arithmetic subtraction that moves value out of the sender balance.
spender is only the allowance mapping key set by approve.
tokens is the allowance value stored by approve.
from is the debit key for balances and the first allowance key in transferFrom.
to is the recipient key of the balances write in transferFrom.
tokens is the operand of the arithmetic subtractions applied to balance and allowance.
tokenOwner is only the first read key of the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender is only the second read key of the allowed mapping in allowance.
spender is both the allowance key and the untrusted address targeted by the external receiveApproval call.
tokens is passed out of the contract as an argument of the external call and stored as allowance.
data bytes are forwarded verbatim to the untrusted external contract.
_addresses is only loop input driving the internal transfer calls.
amounts is only loop input supplying transfer values.
_addresses is only loop input driving the internal transfer calls.
amounts is the operand of the decimals scaling multiplication before transfer.
a is a numeric operand of the guarded addition.
b is a numeric operand of the guarded addition.
a is a numeric operand of the guarded subtraction.
b is a numeric operand of the guarded subtraction.
a is a numeric operand of the guarded multiplication.
b is a numeric operand of the guarded multiplication.
a is the dividend of the guarded division.
b is the divisor of the guarded division.
i exists solely as the loop counter of multiTransfer.
i exists solely as the loop counter of multiTransferDecimals.
c is the internal result variable of SafeMath.add.
c is the internal result variable of SafeMath.sub.
c is the internal result variable of SafeMath.mul.
c is the internal result variable of SafeMath.div.
